High Torque Impact Wrench With Hog Ring Anvil KitProduct detailsComplete tough jobs utilizing the power of the 20V MAX* XR® 3/4" high torque impact wrench. Our highest rated MAX* torque 3/4" impact wrench delivers up to 102% more torque, making it ideal for heavy-duty applications. This tool features a glass-filled nylon housing to help protect against oils & harmful solvents. Other features such as precision wrench mode, which helps prevent overtightening and fastener run-off, as well as a 4-mode push button switch, to easily change speeds and LED brightness, are included to help maximize efficiency and productivity on the jobsite.
